question.text: the reducing power of a metal depends on various factors. Suggest the factor which makes Li metal the strongest reducing agent in aqueous solution

solution.text: Due to high hydration energy of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> cation, the standard reduction potential <math><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> is more negative among all alkali metal cations hence Li acts as strong reducing agent in water.
